```{r pkg-info, include = FALSE}
# Tabla de datasets y funciones exportadas a partir de man/*.Rd
rd_table <- function(kind = c("data", "functions")) {
    kind <- match.arg(kind)
    db <- tools::Rd_db(dir = ".")
    get <- function(rd, tag) {
        x <- rd[vapply(rd, function(e) identical(attr(e, "Rd_tag"), tag), logical(1))]
        if (length(x)) trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", paste(unlist(x[[1]]), collapse = ""))) else NA_character_
    }
    info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(db, function(rd) data.frame(
        name = get(rd, "\\name"),
        title = get(rd, "\\title"),
        keyword = paste(vapply(rd[vapply(rd, function(e) identical(attr(e, "Rd_tag"), "\\keyword"), logical(1))],
                               function(e) paste(unlist(e), collapse = ""), character(1)), collapse = " "),
        source = get(rd, "\\source"),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
    exports <- sub("^export\\((.*)\\)$", "\\1",
                   grep("^export\\(", readLines("NAMESPACE"), value = TRUE))
    is_data <- grepl("datasets", info$keyword)
    ref <- paste0("https://fdzul.github.io/", pkg, "/reference/", info$name, ".html")
    if (kind == "data") {
        x <- info[is_data, ]
        if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
        src <- ifelse(is.na(x$source), "", sub("^<?(https?://[^ >]+)>?.*$", "[link](\\1)", x$source))
        data.frame(Dataset = paste0("[`", x$name, "`](", ref[is_data], ")"),
                   Description = x$title, Source = src)
    } else {
        keep <- !is_data & info$name %in% exports & !grepl("internal", info$keyword)
        x <- info[keep, ]
        if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
        data.frame(Function = paste0("[`", x$name, "()`](", ref[keep], ")"),
                   Description = x$title)
    }
}
tab_data <- rd_table("data")
tab_fun <- rd_table("functions")
```

## Overview

`r pkg_info$goal`

Population is the denominator of every rate and the exposure of every
spatial model. popmex gathers in one place the census population by
municipality, sex and age group (INEGI 2000, 2010 and 2020), the CONAPO
reconstructions and projections for 1990-2040, and the population in 400 m
H3 hexagons (Kontur 2021-2023) to work inside cities.

`r pkg` is part of the [**dengueverse**](https://fdzul.r-universe.dev), a
family of R packages for the surveillance, spatial analysis and control of
dengue and other *Aedes*-borne diseases in Mexico.

```{r functions-section, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
}
```

## Installation

Install the released version from the
[dengueverse R-universe](https://fdzul.r-universe.dev):

```r
install.packages("`r pkg`",
                 repos = c("https://fdzul.r-universe.dev",
                           "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Or the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/`r gh`):

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("`r gh`")
```

## Example

```{r example, eval = FALSE}
library(popmex)

# population in 400 m hexagons of the metropolitan area of Mérida, 2023
merida <- extract_pop(year = 2023, cve_edo = "31",
                      locality = c("Merida", "Uman", "Kanasin"))
sum(merida$population)

# census population of each municipality in 2020 (denominator of rates)
head(pop2020[, c("CVEGEO", "pobtot", "pobfem", "pobmas")])
```

Longer examples are in the
[articles](https://fdzul.github.io/`r pkg`/articles/) of the website.

## Data sources

- **Kontur Population** (`hdx_pop2021`, `hdx_pop2022`, `hdx_pop2023`),
  published in the [Humanitarian Data Exchange](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-mexico).
  License: CC BY 4.0.
- **ITER, Censos de Población y Vivienda 2000, 2010 y 2020**
  (`pop2000`, `pop2010`, `pop2020`), [INEGI](https://www.inegi.org.mx/app/scitel/Default?ev=9).
  Population columns converted to numeric; totals checked against INEGI.
- **Reconstrucción y proyecciones de la población de los municipios de
  México 1990-2040** (`conapop`), [CONAPO](https://www.gob.mx/conapo/documentos/reconstruccion-y-proyecciones-de-la-poblacion-de-los-municipios-de-mexico-1990-2040).

Processing scripts are in [`data-raw/`](https://github.com/`r gh`/tree/main/data-raw).

## How to cite

If you use `r pkg` in a publication, please cite it:

```{r citation, echo = FALSE, comment = ""}
if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    print(citation(pkg), style = "text")
} else {
    cat("citation(\"", pkg, "\")\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r articles-section, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}

    cat("## Publications using ", pkg, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(paste0("- ", articles), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n")
}
```

```{r references-section, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (length(references)) {
```

## Authors and contributors

```{r authors, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
roles <- c(aut = "author", cre = "maintainer", ctb = "contributor",
           dtc = "data contributor", fnd = "funder")
people <- eval(parse(text = desc[, "Authors@R"]))
for (p in people) {
    orcid <- p$comment[["ORCID"]]
    cat("- ", paste(p$given, p$family),
        if (!is.null(orcid)) paste0(" [![ORCID](https://img.shields.io/badge/ORCID-", gsub("-", "--", orcid),
                                    "-A6CE39?logo=orcid&logoColor=white)](https://orcid.org/", orcid, ")"),
        " (", paste(roles[p$role], collapse = ", "), ")\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Acknowledgements

This work was developed at the Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP),
Mexico, in collaboration with the Centro Nacional de Programas Preventivos y
Control de Enfermedades (CENAPRECE) of the Secretaría de Salud.

## Motivation

`r pkg` was born from the need to support evidence-based decisions in the
Vector-Borne Diseases (VBD) program of CENAPRECE of the Secretaría de Salud
of Mexico.
